text:
tia (Comms): Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a single, agreed publish flow for customer-facing summaries and RCAs. Also want a named owner for the redaction checklist and a recurring-incident detection step in the postmortem.

omar (SRE): I can own the redaction checklist. Will include concrete rules: strip PII, remove API keys, replace customer hostnames with GENERIC_HOST_n, and avoid verbatim request/response dumps.

lucy (Customer Success): Timeline ask: initial 72h summary with a 3-line "for your customers" snippet CS can reuse. Full RCA after redaction/legal review; estimate <=14 days unless blocked.

rafa (Legal): 72h summary ok. Any RCA that references customer data or could identify a customer must go through legal review before external release. I'll draft a short consent template & sign-off steps.

ops-bot: Reminder: create incident-task with 72h due for initial customer summary.

tia (Comms): Proposed minimal statuspage copy and 72h template below — please quick thumbs up or edits.

STATUSPAGE SHORT: "We experienced elevated errors affecting <service>. Mitigation was applied and service returned to normal at <end>. A follow-up summary will be posted within 72 hours."

72H CUSTOMER SUMMARY (outline):
- Impact snapshot (who/what)
- Mitigation performed
- For your customers (3-line CS-ready blurb)
- Next steps & owner + ETA
- Support contact

PUBLIC RCA (post-redaction): timeline, root cause, remediation, verification, owner + ETA, link to internal postmortem. Redaction per checklist.

omar (SRE): I'll also add a `recurring-pattern-check` query to the postmortem template to scan the last 180 days for matching error signatures. If matches >1, flag `recurring=true`. That helps comms decide proactive outreach.

lucy (Customer Success): Good. If `recurring=true`, CS wants a recommended outreach level (email, account outreach, or no contact) included in the 72h summary so teams can act quickly.

rafa (Legal): For consent: if we include a customer quote or any identifying example, require explicit written consent with the exact text to be published. Sign-off chain: SRE -> Legal -> Comms. I'll add examples of disallowed content to the checklist.

tia (Comms): Action owners & due dates:
- Redaction checklist: omar (owner) — due 48h
- Statuspage + 72h templates: tia (owner) — due 24h
- Consent template & sign-off flow: rafa (owner) — due 72h
- CS paste-ready snippets: lucy (owner) — due 3 business days

omar (SRE): :+1: will open PR with checklist + recurring-pattern query.

lucy (Customer Success): :+1: will prepare CS blurb and email snippets.

rafa (Legal): :+1: will post consent template and sign-off steps in the docs repo.

tia (Comms): I'll create the incident task and schedule a 20m sync to walk through the checklist after PR lands. Leaving thread open for edge cases (regulated customers, air-gapped deployments). Tag me and legal if you spot one.

ops-bot: Task created: INCIDENT-8001 (customer-comms-followup) — initial summary due in 72h.

omar (SRE): Shared PR link once ready.

tia (Comms): Thanks everyone. React with :+1: here when you've completed your task so ops-bot can auto-close the action.
